summary.text: John Janigian is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Rockingham 25 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8 primary.
Janigian is a real estate broker, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: John Janigian lives in Salem, New Hampshire.
He earned a bachelor's degree in chemistry from Tufts University in 1980 and a master's degree in computer science from Boston University in 1985.

His career experience includes working as an associate broker with Berkshire Hathaway Verani Realty, the CEO of property development and management with Janigian Associates, and the director of professional services at Bowstreet, Inc.
Ballotpedia lists Janigian's tenure in the New Hampshire House of Representatives as beginning in 2016.
